jobs.title: Zwei Studentische Teilzeitkräfte Internet (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly student side-role (Studentische Teilzeitkraft) requiring current enrolment at a German university, which is excluded by policy. It is also a communications/web-editing role that requires ongoing German enrolment the candidate (at LSE) does not hold.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow Klima (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: The posting requires at least five years of relevant professional experience as an essential, plus an established political network and policy-advisory track record — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant profile. Although DGAP and the climate/foreign-policy focus are in a strong interest zone, the experience requirement is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Fundraising Manager (m/w/d) für Testamentsspenden
jobs.reason: Ineligible — a Manager title requiring 3–5 years of professional experience in fundraising and marketing, which the candidate (student-assistant experience only) clearly lacks. The role is also a fundraising/marketing specialism outside the candidate's research and policy focus.

jobs.title: Bote/Botin, Pförtner:in, Postverteiler:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: This is a mailroom / porter / courier service role requiring prior experience in a post-room and a Class B driving licence, with duties entirely clerical-logistical. It has no research, policy, or analytical content and does not match the candidate's profile or interest zones on any axis.
